fields.summary_ko.0: Tesla (TSLA) at $380 is down -15.48% YTD, requiring a 57.8% increase to reach $600, while Wall Street's average target of $412.48 implies +8.5%: FSD subscriptions at 1.74M show YoY +67% growth, with Robotaxi expected to become a major revenue driver in Q3-Q4 2027.
fields.summary_ko.1: Q3 operating profit declined 55.79% to $718M, with R&D expenses surging from $1.63B to $2.76B: 2027 EPS consensus expects $2.1592, though estimates have been adjusted downward from $2.2520 over the past 90 days.
